Three places in the REST module's main code call `saveLocation`, and a test class calls it too. I found them with two regex searches and didn't open the files, so I haven't checked the surrounding code.

- **`LocationResource1_8.java`, line 223:** `return Context.getLocationService().saveLocation(location);`. This is the main location resource's save path, so it is the most exposed. It returns the result of `saveLocation`, so a change to the return value would also reach callers here.
- **`LocationAttributeResource1_9.java`, lines 101 and 113:** both call `Context.getLocationService().saveLocation(delegate.getLocation());`. This resource saves the parent location when a location attribute is changed. I didn't read the surrounding methods, so I don't know which operations those two lines belong to.
- **`LocationController1_9Test.java`, lines 164, 225 and 242:** these call `service.saveLocation(location)` in tests, so they could break if the behavior changed.
